The '''Tiems system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Belderone sector/Legends|Belderone sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained at least one [[Tiems (planet)|planet]], which had a [[Tiems|city]] named after the system.

==Behind the scenes==
The city of Tiems, and the subsequent [[Battle of Tiems|battle]] fought near the city between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], was first mentioned in ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', published by [[West End Games]] in [[1990]]. In [[2009]], ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' included a reference to a "Tiems system" in the appendix. This article assumes that the city of Tiems is located on a planet within the Tiems system.
